basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and lore enthusiast who has been a part of the Reddit community since its early days. Originally from Toronto, Canada, now living in Austin, Texas. Works as a software developer with a passion for storytelling in video games. Often online in the evenings and late at night, balancing work with a love for gaming and online discussions. Enjoys exploring complex narratives in games and sharing insights with others. In a long-term relationship with a fellow gamer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive background in software development with a bachelor's degree in computer science. Self-taught in video game lore, particularly in FromSoftware titles, through years of gameplay and online research. Actively engages with educational content to stay updated on technology and gaming trends.
